target.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning
target.body:
Closes #98200

Supersedes #97903 and builds on the fresh-session containment landed in #110226.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `openclaw agent` could execute a turn twice after an uncertain CLI-to-Gateway disconnect: the detached Gateway run could continue while the CLI automatically started a fresh embedded fallback, duplicating model cost, mutating tool effects, and possibly `--deliver` output.

## Why This Change Was Made

The CLI now reconnects and calls `agent.wait` for the original run, then performs a cache-only idempotent replay to retrieve its exact terminal response. The Gateway rejects a replay-only cache miss without admitting new work. If the original outcome still cannot be proven, the CLI fails closed by default; `--rerun-on-ambiguous` is the explicit opt-in escape hatch and still uses an isolated `gateway-fallback-*` session.

This keeps result recovery at the Gateway run owner boundary and avoids transcript-tail heuristics. It also covers disconnects where the CLI never observed the `accepted` frame, because recovery uses the original idempotency key generated before dispatch.

## User Impact

Users no longer get an automatic duplicate execution after an ambiguous Gateway close or timeout. Successful recovery prints the original result, known terminal failures remain failures, and unknown outcomes stop safely with the run id and a warning that no fallback started. Users who knowingly accept duplicate-side-effect risk can opt into a fresh embedded rerun with `--rerun-on-ambiguous`.

This is a compatibility-sensitive change from the automatic fresh-session fallback currently on `main`.

## Evidence

- Focused Vitest run on Node 22.22.3: 4 shards passed, 119 tests passed, 1 existing test skipped.
  - `packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/error-codes.test.ts`
  - `packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/agent.test.ts`
  - `src/gateway/server-methods/agent-request-preflight.replay-only.test.ts`
  - `src/cli/program/register.agent.test.ts`
  - `src/commands/agent-via-gateway.test.ts`
- `oxfmt --check` passed for all 11 touched files.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Full `check:changed` was correctly classified as an all-workspace remote lane, but local Blacksmith authentication and the fallback AWS broker credentials were unavailable. Draft PR CI is required before this is ready for review.
- Mandatory autoreview was attempted with Codex Sol, Codex Terra, Claude, and Pi. No reviewer produced a verdict: both Codex runs failed in the engine process, Claude's local OAuth token was revoked, and Pi was not installed. This draft remains dependent on CI and maintainer/bot review before being marked ready.
